review_protocol.reviewer: Codex uniform contact-sheet review plus full-video decoded metrics

exact25_varlen_no_guard.notes: The gymnast is reduced to a small ghosted figure and the ribbon/background become dark smeared texture across the sequence.

exact25_varlen_guarded.notes: Early Dense steps do not recover the exact-budget route: the subject remains weak and ghosted and the ribbon is dominated by red horizontal smears.

top_p_varlen_no_guard.notes: The gymnast, full-body motion, and ribbon geometry remain recognizable throughout all nine uniformly sampled frames; quality differs from Dense but does not collapse.

top_p_varlen_guarded.notes: The historical upstream-policy transfer remains close to the matched Dense trajectory and preserves the subject and ribbon.

decision_note: Top-p without the Dense guard passes while exact-25% with the same varlen backend and an enabled guard still collapses. The selection policy, not the guard, is the primary causal difference.
